name: The Threshold
notes: Gate I opener. Teaches, in this order and one at a time: walk, jump a gap, climb a ladder, take treasure, find the key, use the sealed gate. Nothing is combined and nothing is timed. The whole room is visible from the start position, so the player can see the gate they are trying to reach before they know how to open it.

required_objects.note: Deliberately past the spike gap, so the jump has to be learned before the gate can be opened.

hazards.note: Authored as tile 08 in the map as well; this row is what the debug overlay and telemetry label.

optional_routes.label: expert: take t_tablet_2 on the terrace before climbing, costing the safe return trip

solution: From the start at (2,10) walk right along the floor, collecting t_tablet_1 at (4,10). The ladder foot at (6,10) is the checkpoint. Continue right; a single tile of reed stakes sits at (8,10). Jump it from (7,10) to (9,10) - the gap is one tile and well inside a standing jump. Take k_threshold at (13,10). Return left to the ladder at column 6 and climb. The ladder passes through the terrace floor at row 5 and stops flush with its surface, so step off to either side at (5,4) or (7,4). t_tablet_2 sits at (2,4) to the left, off the critical path. Walk right along the terrace to column 10 and climb the second ladder, which passes through the gate walk at row 2 and again stops flush. Step right onto the walk, take t_seal_1 at (12,1), and enter the gate at (14,1), which unseals once the key is held.
